hypothesis_text: Dynamic SBG generalizes across all registered semantics-preserving (SP) transformation types with bounded per-type variance.
pre_registered_criterion: Per-SP-type AUROC spread <= 0.10 across all registered SP types for B07 Dynamic SBG.
verdict_scope: All 7 evaluated methods (B07, B08, B06, V1 static SBG, AST, TF-IDF, embedding baseline) fail the criterion. No method is exempt.

key_numbers.pct_sp_types_inversion_resolved: varies by method; for B07 minority resolved

notes: Failures were not aggregated away or excluded. SC-3 and SP-2 root causes independently investigated in Waves 3-4 and are disclosed as genuine limitations, not hidden.
